definitions.explanation: A direct apology, often used when you have done something wrong or caused someone trouble.

examples.japanese: {約束|やくそく}を{忘|わす}れて、ごめんなさい。
examples.english: I'm sorry for forgetting our promise.

examples.japanese: ごめんなさい、{私|わたし}が{悪|わる}かったです。
examples.english: I'm sorry, it was my fault.

examples.japanese: {遅|おく}れてごめんなさい。{電車|でんしゃ}が{止|と}まっていました。
examples.english: I'm sorry for being late. The train was stopped.

examples.japanese: ごめんなさい、{今日|きょう}は{用事|ようじ}があるので、{一緒|いっしょ}に{行|い}けません。
examples.english: I'm sorry, I have things to do today so I can't go with you.

notes: ごめんなさい is a more heartfelt apology than すみません, often used when admitting fault. The casual form is ごめん or ごめんね. It can also be used when refusing an invitation or request (ごめんなさい、{今日|きょう}は{無理|むり}です - Sorry, I can't today).
